run_psro_kuhn_poker: run PSRO on kuhn_poker game with 2 players using exact best response oracle
run_psro_leduc_poker: run PSRO on leduc_poker game with 3 players using policy gradient oracle
run_psro_dqn: run PSRO with DQN oracle on kuhn_poker game for 100 GPSRO iterations
run_psro_alpharank: run PSRO with alpharank meta strategy method on sequential game
run_psro_rectified: run PSRO with rectified training strategy selector on kuhn_poker game
